annotations.title: Import ElevenLabs success criteria as checks

description: For a project connected to an ElevenLabs agent: add a custom check for each success criterion the agent has in ElevenLabs, named "Missed goal: <criterion>", as the connection settings' import button does. A check whose name is already taken is left as it is, so importing twice adds nothing. Reads the criteria saved when the connection was last saved; after changing them in ElevenLabs, save the connection again with its agent id (Settings, or the setup API) to read the agent afresh.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
